epic.title: Teacher Timetable & Schedule Module
epic.body: Provides teachers with personal schedule visibility and cross-functional views of classroom utilization and peer schedules to coordinate academic activities.

features.title: Personal & Peer Schedule Management
features.body: Teachers can view their assigned class periods, monitor free slots, and check the availability/schedules of other teachers within their assigned classes.

stories.title: View Personal Weekly Schedule
stories.body: As a teacher, I want to list and filter my own periods by day and week so I can prepare for my daily classes and identify my free periods.
acceptanceCriteria: List: Display a timeline of periods for the logged-in teacher.
Filter: Toggle between 'Day' and 'Week' view modes.
Details: Display Subject, Class (e.g., 7A, 8B), Room Number, and specific Time range for each period.
Visualization: Differentiate 'Regular Periods', 'BREAKS', and 'Free Periods' using distinct color coding.

stories.title: View Peer Teacher Schedules
stories.body: As a teacher, I want to view the schedules of other teachers who teach the same classes as me to coordinate multidisciplinary activities or substitutions.
acceptanceCriteria: List/Update: Ability to switch the view from 'My Classes' to 'Other Teachers'.
Filter: Dropdown to select a specific peer teacher from a list of related colleagues.
Search: Ability to filter peer schedules by specific class and day.

stories.title: Teacher-Specific Timetable Retrieval (Backend)
stories.body: Backend API to fetch timetable records filtered by the authenticated teacher's ID and associated metadata.
acceptanceCriteria: GET: Endpoint to retrieve all periods assigned to a teacher across all classes.
GET: Endpoint to list peer teachers mapped to the same organizational branch or class group.
Read: Ensure data includes period ID, subject, room type, and start/end timestamps.

features.title: Classroom & Lab Allocation View
features.body: Provides visibility into where a teacher needs to be (Classroom vs Lab) based on the subject and room type assignment.

stories.title: Differentiate Classroom and Lab Assignments
stories.body: As a teacher, I want to see the specific room type (e.g., Lab 3 vs Room 201) to ensure I have the right resources ready for the session.
acceptanceCriteria: Display: Each period card must show the Room/Lab name and an associated location icon.
Metadata: Distinguish between 'classroom' and 'lab' room types in the period details.
